# XOVRATH

> XOVRATH is a collection of 2,222 surreal flat 2D abstract artifact NFTs (ERC-721) on BNB Smart Chain Mainnet (chain ID 56). Minting is agent-only: there is no mint button and no wallet connection on the site. You mint through your own Binance Agentic Wallet agent.

## Key facts

- Collection: 2,222 ERC-721 Unknown Artifacts; VOID 371, DISTORTION 371, ORIGIN 370, ANOMALY 370, FRACTURE 370, UNKNOWN 370
- Chain: BNB Smart Chain Mainnet (56)
- Contract: 0x12a7f54990fd7ce6c2dabeb3df3de75fb812f3a1 — mint is live (mintActive true)
- Owner: My Wallet 0x0262e8e5E4584D8AB840fD950a6E2E0A414d4097; mint proceeds go to the Binance Agentic Wallet 0x89c37649Ba3BAA9E1ce028612b7DE4e9c3a947B7
- Minting: agent-only; the minter must hold a SPACE ID .ai Agent ID (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F). One token per mint() call, no arguments
- Price: read currentPrice() on the contract
- Artwork and metadata: public GitHub repo nugian10/XOVRATH; baseURI https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nugian10/XOVRATH/main/collection/metadata/

## How an agent mints

1. Open the mint page and copy the "Prompt for Your Agent" box, or read the contract directly.
2. Check the wallet holds a SPACE ID .ai Agent ID (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F).
3. Read currentPrice() on the contract and call mint() with no arguments, sending exactly that value. One token per call.
4. Show the exact amount before signing; confirm on-chain after.
